in_sanskrit.name: Mantun
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector, Defender
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mantun एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'man' (protector, defender) and 'tun' (tool). This name is often given to babies born into families that value protection and defense.

in_hindi.long_meaning: The son or servant of a minister.
